acceptance_checks.criterion: All declared causal-design deliverables and mode-contract directory exist.
One interpretable primary contrast and strongest baseline selected only by frozen DEV rule.
Producer, reviewer and gatekeeper are distinct; producer does not self-accept.
M11-M14 can falsify LLM necessity, ready-answer copying, field reliance and length explanations.
Mode visibility, hidden fields, budgets, ranking, token tolerance, estimands and pivot rules are machine-readable and frozen before HOLDOUT.

known_limitations: The primary M6-M14 estimand is a total compiled-interface bundle effect; execution, structure and conclusion mechanisms are identified only through secondary contrasts.
M14 token matching may require deterministic truncation; implementation must prove mandatory source assertions are preserved without outcome-dependent choices.
Teacher modes are eligible for B* only if their final artifacts satisfy the same matching envelope; feasibility must be verified before GATE-001.

The repository validate_causal_design.py is currently an artifact-level wrapper; producer used deterministic YAML/cross-file checks, and independent reviewer must decide whether a dedicated semantic validator is required.
Smallest meaningful gain and powered sample size remain WP-006 responsibilities and are not invented here.
unexpected_findings: M14 is best treated as a constructed token-matched instantiation of one globally selected B*, not as an independently selectable source mode.
The original M6-M3 comparison is retained only as diagnostic; it is prohibited as the headline causal result.
An unfavorable M11 result can remove the need for an LLM renderer without invalidating the value of trusted execution.
